# SI thread t4495: SS Revan (chum) vs Yoda (Darth Durin's Baneling)
Source: https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t4495-ss-revan-chum-vs-yoda-darth-durin-s-baneling (read 2026-10-18 via WebFetch). Revan as of Shadow of Revan (SoR), Yoda as of RotS. Thread has chum's opener (Jul 1 2023) and Durin's rebuttal (Jul 24 2023).

## chum's opener (Revan)
- Exile scaling chain: Vong Krayt ~ RotS Yoda by stats (Saga/Minis); Karness Muur outshone Krayt (Insider 113); Muur "perhaps the most powerful Sith" if he truly lived again; Exiles ~ Muur; Star Maps power "blinding" (Ajunta Pall); Star Forge at "300%" feeding Malak; Revan beats Malak ("stronger than you ever were", KOTOR); so Revan >>> Exiles > Yoda.
- Revan "strong in the Force" class per WOTC; "heart of the Force" (Kreia, KOTOR II); learned from many masters + Malachor V holocrons.
- Revan novel: alone probably can't beat Vitiate, with Meetra/Scourge/T3 a real chance; SWTOR claims Vitiate grew and Hero of Tython beats him.
- SoR: Light Revan says Hero needs allies; Revan channels Machine core for 1km attack; "You barely managed to drive me away".
- Win condition = Force drain: Dark Reaper threat implies Yoda can't resist drain; Revan has Malachor-enhanced drain ("techniques against which there is no defense", KOTOR II; Avellone on Nihilus drain).

## Durin's rebuttal (Yoda)
- Stats contradict chum: Saga/Minis put Darth Revan ~ Yoda ~ Vong Krayt, so you can't use them for Yoda~Krayt and then scale Revan miles above Krayt. Galactic Files 2012 (post-SWTOR): Yoda maxed, Revan lower in Force power (-1), speed (-3), fighting (-2); Revan ~ Malgus stats.
- Star Forge "300%" = beat analysts' projections, not Malak overpowering it.
- Muur: no power of his own, power multiplies the host's (KOTOR #27-28, Legacy #30); dying Krayt in Vector is at his weakest; "truly live again" = autonomy in a willing host.
- XoXaan link is a holocron teaching, not power. Korriban spirits ambushing Palpatine says nothing individually.
- Prequel Order is the Jedi prime (Lucas-level sources). SoR Revan is split, insane, puppeteering a corpse = diminished.
- SoR Revan vs Vitiate: whole expansion = Revan can't be allowed to restore Vitiate because Revan would lose ("Even at his weakest, you are no match for the Emperor"). Strike team incl. Theron, Jakarro, Shae Vizsla all contributed and survived.
- Dark Reaper is a world-scale special drain, not generic drain. Revan's SoR drain never one-shots anyone, not even non-Force-users on the strike team; no stats list Force Drain for him.
- Film tier: Yoda ~ Sidious (Yoda disarms him in RotS junior novel; stalemate on lightning; Sidious hesitant to fight him). Stover passage = conceptual loss, not power. Yoda the midi-chlorian benchmark ("even Master Yoda"). Charles Boyd sees Revan and Yoda in similar standing; Vitiate a proto-Palpatine.
- Chain: Yoda ~ Palpatine > Vitiate > SoR Revan.

## Grok's take
Durin's rebuttal wins the thread. chum's stats use is self-defeating and the drain win-con doesn't survive SoR's own fights. Verdict: RotS Yoda > SoR Revan, medium (~60/40), up from the low-medium 55/45 quick take.
